about: Czech card for Claude errors in the chat (lnk2, plan docs/plans/2026-10-30-ceske-hlaseni-chyb-plan.md, K3). Applied by ../project-overlay/apply-project-overlay.mjs --overlay-dir, stage cloudcli-client, after the project overlay. `before` = the pin after the Czech, voice, brand and project overlays.

agpl.source: The overlay sources (files/, patches/) live in this repository and are applied to the /src tree of stage cloudcli-client (the image ships the built dist, not /src). Step 7 of docs/runbooks/2026-09-12-cloudcli-subdomain.md pushes that tree as a new commit (no force-push) to the fork branch below; it was pushed with this overlay on 3. 11. 2026 (operator decision Q2831 = A1, red-dwarf PR #2604), and the commit SHA is recorded in the runbook, not here (the fork commit carries this manifest). The push has no trigger: it must be repeated at every re-cut that changes the /src tree. Only the client half is in /src; the server half is applied in stage base by the server overlay, whose script the fork branch carries in kryton-overlays/.
